items.title: Yale scientists may have found a shortcut to the anti-aging benefits of eating less
items.summary: Yale researchers have discovered that moderate calorie restriction reduces an immune protein linked to aging and chronic inflammation, apparently independently of weight loss. Blocking this protein could potentially mimic some of the benefits of eating less and help people stay healthier for longer.
